name: pendelum-airlines
description: A physics-based flying taxi with a very lively suspended cabin.

scripts.test:flights: node scripts/verify-flights.js && node scripts/verify-freight-flights.js && node scripts/verify-metal-flights.js && node scripts/verify-logistics-flights.js && node scripts/verify-fire-flights.js
scripts.test:smoke: node scripts/verify-flights.js && node scripts/verify-freight-flights.js && node scripts/verify-smoke-flights.js

scripts.verify:full: npm run check && npm test && npm run test:flights && npm run build
